rules.title: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance (Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance when evicting for owner move-in. Starting January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, and qualifying households get an additional $6,471. The amounts are indexed to inflation each year.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471 (effective January 1, 2026)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted for owner move-in under the Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.effective_date_phrase: will go into effect on January 1, 2026

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (Ellis Implementation Ordinance)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay the same relocation assistance to tenants evicted so the owner can take a property off the rental housing market. Starting January 1, 2026, the standard payment is $19,413, and qualifying households get an additional $6,471. The amounts are indexed to inflation each year.
rules.key_value: Standard payment $19,413; additional payment for qualifying households $6,471 (effective January 1, 2026)
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market under the Ellis Implementation Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.effective_date_phrase: will go into effect on January 1, 2026
